'''Amadaine 1 (June 8)'''

==Events==
* [[998 NE]] - [[Ba'alzamon]] gives orders in a gathering of [[Darkfriends]] concerning [[Rand]], [[Mat]], and [[Perrin]].
* [[999 NE]] - [[Perrin]]'s party leaves the [[Stone of Tear]] and enters the Tairen [[Waygate]].
* [[999 NE]] - [[Elayne]] and [[Nynaeve]] leave for [[Tanchico]] aboard the ''[[Wavedancer]]'', where Elayne finds some [[Windfinders]] can [[channel]].
* [[999 NE]] - News of Rand and of [[Mazrim Taim]]'s escape reach [[Tar Valon]]. [[Siuan Sanche]] assembles the [[Hall]]. The [[novice]] [[Sahra Covenry]] is killed by the [[Black Ajah]].
* [[999 NE]] - Rand leaves [[Tear]] with [[Moiraine]], [[Lan]], [[Mat]], [[Egwene]], [[Aviendha]], and the [[Aiel]]. They use a [[portal stone]] that takes them to [[Chaendaer]]. Rand, Mat, Moiraine, and Aviendha enter [[Rhuidean]]. Rand goes through the [[glass columns]] and Mat enters the doorframe ''[[ter'angreal]]''. Egwene starts her training with the [[Wise Ones]].
</noinclude>
